system.notes:
This massive, ethereal vessel skims across the fabric of reality, a ghostly galleon said to be steered by lost souls. It glides silently through the night, appearing where the veil between worlds is thinnest.

AC 20, HP 81, ATK 4 spectral cannons (near) +10 (2d10), MV far (sail), S +0, D +0, C +5, I +3, W +4, Ch +0, AL N, LV 17

Legendary Vessel. The Shadowbarge is a ship of legend and is immune to conventional damage. It can only be harmed by magical sources.

Soul Anchor. The Shadowbarge is anchored in reality by 2d6 wraiths that man it. If the souls are released or put to rest, the Shadowbarge may fade from existence.

Ethereal Sailing. Traverses ethereal and material planes at will, bypassing physical obstacles and appearing without warning. Can only be halted by local festivals, where it docks to partake in the celebrations.

Wail of the Damned. Once per day, the Shadowbarge can emit a ghastly wail. All who hear it within double near DC 15 WIS or be paralyzed with fear for 1d4 rounds.

Treasure of the Beyond. Holds countless treasures plundered from sunken ships. Roll with advantage on treasure tables.

Shadowbarge design by Taylor Seely-Wright, used with permission. Illustration by Matt Morrow.
